readiness_policy.integration_skeleton: local VF functions provide an integration skeleton; supply target context and validate compilation, precision and performance in the target project
readiness_policy.annotated_excerpt: key VF code is vendored locally with explanations; supply omitted class context and branches, then validate in the target project
readiness_policy.reference_only: local material supports algorithm and shape/layout selection; establish the target build contract before implementation
